verdict.rationale: Radar can be automated headlessly. It has REST API endpoints for reviews (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), early fraud warnings and value lists, plus an official Stripe CLI. Sandbox test cards also produce deterministic risk levels, which suits CI testing. However, custom rules and risk settings are documented as Dashboard workflows, and a community report cites a lack of easy programmatic control. Missing for 10: API or CLI management of Radar rules and risk settings, Radar-specific CLI or CI workflow documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
